description: A static `<md>` in a component body keeps its markdown lines (a `###` heading, a blank line) and renders once per instance; each instance's heading gets its own id.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY) · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F2 "yes a." (same closed element/attribute set, same §5.2 URL guard)
rationale: §67.2: the body is read as written (dedent only); §67.6: heading ids are deduped page-wide — a slot contributes nothing to a slug, so `### ${title}` slugs to `section` and the second instance gets `section-1`.
